measures.title: Athens County Tax Levy – Health Department (additional)
measures.summary: An additional tax for Athens County to maintain and operate the Athens City-County Health Department. The county auditor estimates it will collect $1,520,051 a year at up to 1 mill, or $35 for each $100,000 of market value, for 10 years starting in 2026, first due in 2027.
measures.yesMeans: The new 1-mill health department levy would be approved for 10 years.
measures.noMeans: The new health department levy would not be approved.
